carbonet.description: Check that everything is ready before you start working — that you're signed in, that your access is granted, that the stack is up to date, and that this folder is set up. Prints a plain-English ✅/❌ list with a fix for anything that's wrong, plus what changed since you were last here and a suggested first move, and never shows a key or password. Use at the start of a session, when something stops working, or when you're not sure whether your setup is right.
